config.description: State Store Task configuration - Accesses a Dapr state store component to cache data within the workflow pipeline

storeName.description: Optional Dapr state store component name. When empty, the executing runtime's DAPR_STATE_STORE_NAME configuration value is used.

key.description: Cache key targeted by get, set and single-key delete

keys.description: Optional list of keys for bulk delete

query.description: Optional Dapr state Query API filter (JSON) for tag/pattern based delete

value.description: Value written by set (any JSON value)

ttlInSeconds.description: Optional time-to-live in seconds applied on set (Dapr ttlInSeconds metadata)

etag.description: Optional ETag for optimistic concurrency on read/write

metadata.description: Optional additional metadata passed to the Dapr state store operation

config.description: Cache Aside Task configuration - Read-through cache pattern: reads from a Dapr state store, and on a cache miss executes the referenced source task, writes the shaped result back with a TTL, and returns it.

key.description: Static cache key. Optional - a dynamic key may be derived at runtime via an input mapping or the keyExpression.

storeName.description: Optional Dapr state store component name used as the cache. When empty, the executing runtime's DAPR_STATE_STORE_NAME configuration value is used.

ttlInSeconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds for cached entries. When absent or 0, the entry has no expiry.

consistency.description: Optional consistency mode passed through to the Dapr state store.

sourceTask.description: Reference to the task executed on a cache miss.

flow.description: Source task flow. Defaults to 'sys-tasks' when omitted.

sourceMapping.description: Optional mapping (ScriptCode) applied to the raw source result before it is cached and returned.

keyExpression.description: Optional Dynamic Expresso expression (ScriptCode with location='dynamicExpresso') whose evaluated string result overrides the cache key at runtime.

bypassOnCacheError.description: When true (default), cache read/write failures fall back to the source task instead of failing the pipeline. When false, cache errors surface as task failure.

forceRefresh.description: When true, the cache read is skipped: the source task is always executed and the cache entry overwritten.

config.description: FanOut Task configuration - Executes a referenced inner task once per item of a runtime-resolved collection, in parallel, and joins the per-item outcomes into a single output. Only inline mode is available in this phase. Two runtime rules cannot be expressed here and are enforced at parse/execution time: execution.itemTimeoutSeconds must be less than or equal to execution.batchTimeoutSeconds, and exactly one item source must be configured - either itemsPath on this config or ItemSelector on the task's mapping, never both and never neither.

mode.description: Execution mode. Only 'inline' is accepted; the value 'durable' is reserved for a later phase and is rejected at parse time, so it must not be authored.

itemsPath.description: JSONPath (dot-path subset, property navigation only - no filters, wildcards, indices or slices) into instance data selecting the item collection. Must start with '$.'. Mutually exclusive with the mapping's ItemSelector: configuring both, or neither, is a runtime execution error. A missing path resolves to an empty batch; a path resolving to a non-array value throws.

itemAlias.description: Readability label for ONE item of the batch (e.g. 'document', 'payment'), surfaced on the batch log line and on every item trace span. It plays no role in input binding - renaming it can never change what a script reads. When unset, the runtime substitutes the neutral label 'item'.

task.description: Reference to the inner task executed once per item. All four properties are required. Resolved once per batch and cloned per item. A reference to another FanOut task (type 21) is rejected by the executor.

execution.description: Batch execution limits. itemTimeoutSeconds must be less than or equal to batchTimeoutSeconds - that cross-field rule is enforced at parse time by the runtime, not here.

maxDegreeOfParallelism.description: Batch-local concurrency cap. Deliberately low by default: an unbounded fan-out overloads whatever the inner task calls. A global ceiling caps all batches in the process on top of this.

itemTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-item deadline in seconds. Must be less than or equal to batchTimeoutSeconds.

batchTimeoutSeconds.description: Whole-batch deadline in seconds. Items still running when it fires are cancelled and counted as FanOut:BatchTimeout failures.

join.description: How per-item outcomes combine into the task outcome.

policy.description: Join policy. 'all' succeeds only when every item succeeded and the batch did not time out (remaining items are cancelled on the first failure). 'allSettled' always succeeds - partial failure is data, not an error. 'quorum' succeeds when succeeded >= minSuccess. 'firstSuccess' succeeds when at least one item succeeded (remaining items are cancelled on the first success). For an empty batch 'all' and 'allSettled' succeed while 'quorum' and 'firstSuccess' fail.

minSuccess.description: Minimum successful items. Required when policy is 'quorum'; ignored for the other policies.

resultKey.description: Instance data key the default output packaging writes item results under, alongside a '{resultKey}Summary' object. Ignored once the task's mapping overrides OutputHandler.

ordered.description: Accepted for forward compatibility with a future durable mode. In inline mode it is a no-op - item results are always returned sorted by item index.

errorBoundary.description: Per-ITEM error boundary, applied independently to every item through the same engine machinery a state or transition error boundary uses. A retry-exhausted item becomes one failed entry in the result set; it does not by itself stop the batch - the join policy decides that.

onError.description: Error handling rules evaluated in priority order (lower value first). Empty array is valid (no error rules).

items.description: A single error handling rule within the per-item error boundary

enumDescriptions: Abort (0) - Abort execution. Transition must not be set.
Retry (1) - Retry with configured retry policy. RetryPolicy is required.
Rollback (2) - Rollback to compensation state. Transition is required (transition key).
Notify (4) - Send notification and transition. Transition is required (transition key).
Log (5) - Log only, does not affect flow
action.description: Action to take when an error is caught by the per-item boundary. Constraint: Abort -> no transition; Retry -> retryPolicy required.

errorTypes.description: Exception type names to match (e.g., ValidationException). Omit or use '*' to match all. Items must not be empty or whitespace.

errorCodes.description: Error codes to match (e.g., 'Task:409', '404', 'FanOut:ItemTimeout'). Omit or use '*' to match all. Items must not be empty or whitespace.

transition.description: Workflow transition key to trigger when this rule matches. Required when action is Notify or Rollback. Must not be set when action is Abort.

priority.description: Rule priority. Lower values evaluated first. Default 100; use higher values (e.g. 999) for wildcard/fallback rules.

retryPolicy.description: Configures retry behavior for the matched item. Required when action is Retry. MaxDelay must be greater than or equal to initialDelay.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts (0 or greater; values above 100 are discouraged)

initialDelay.description: Initial delay before first retry (ISO 8601 duration). Must be greater than zero.

maxDelay.description: Maximum delay between retries (ISO 8601 duration). Must be greater than or equal to initialDelay.

useJitter.description: Whether to add random jitter to retry delays

logOnly.description: If true, only logs the error without affecting execution flow

then.description: When join.policy is 'quorum', join.minSuccess is required and must be >= 1 (task parsing fails otherwise).
